versions.changelog:
## Pierre's Year-Round Seeds 1.0

First release.

- Pierre sells the spring, summer and fall seeds of his shop all year, also in winter.
- Out-of-season seeds cost more: choose +25 %, +50 % (default) or +100 % in the config.
- Seeds he only sells from year 2 on (garlic, rice, red cabbage, artichoke) still wait for year 2.
- Crops still only grow in their own season.

## Pierre's Year-Round Seeds 1.1

Sandy's Oasis shop joins in.

- Sandy sells her seasonal seeds all year: rhubarb seeds (spring), starfruit seeds (summer) and beet seeds (fall), also in winter.
- They use the same surcharge setting as Pierre's seeds: at +50 % (default) rhubarb seeds cost 150g instead of 100g, starfruit seeds 600g instead of 400g and beet seeds 30g instead of 20g.
- In their own season, Sandy's stock and prices stay as they are. Cactus seeds and everything else in her shop are untouched.
- Your surcharge setting carries over. Crops still only grow in their own season.

## Pierre's Year-Round Seeds 1.2

The settings are now in German too.

- The surcharge setting has a readable name, description and value names in the in-game config menu (Generic Mod Config Menu): "Out-of-season surcharge" (+25 %, +50 %, +100 %) in English, "Aufpreis außerhalb der Saison" in German. Players with the game set to German see the setting in German; everyone else keeps the English one.
- Same seeds, same prices at Pierre's and Sandy's; your setting carries over and nothing else changes.
